name: Calcium Dental Bones for Medium Breeds
label: 90 g

texts.about_this_item: Zubochistiki calcium dental bones for medium-breed dogs of 10–25 kg (4 pieces). Excellent at removing plaque, preventing tartar and fighting gum disease; the patented structure makes cleaning as effective as mechanical brushing. 100% natural product, enriched with calcium to strengthen bones and joints.
texts.ingredient_information: Wheat protein, whey protein, emulsified fats, lactose, calcium carbonate, sodium caseinate, essential oils, glycerin, natural flavourings (milk). Guaranteed analysis: protein 51.31%, moisture 13%, ash 6.77%, fat 6.53%, calcium 2.4%, fibre 0.49%.
